segments.text: We first tried WhatsApp Business in 207. At the time, customer demand mattered because manual reconciliation wasted staff time.
The biggest issue was Policy uncertainty. Without steady power in Maiduguri, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after WhatsApp Business—we saw Operational efficiency within 9 months.
Policy-wise, Tax compliance shaped our move. We adjusted by Staff training.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during New Year.
